# Institute for Childhood Preparedness

> Leading provider of emergency preparedness training and safety solutions for early childhood education centers across the United States.

The Institute for Childhood Preparedness (ICP) specializes in active shooter training, security assessments, and emergency response programs designed specifically for child care centers and early childhood educators. The organization combines hands-on training, compliance support, and practical tools to help early childhood programs protect children and staff.

## Key Topics

- Active Shooter Preparedness
- Emergency Preparedness
- Early Childhood Education
- Safety Training
- Staff Training
- Child Safety
- Site Assessment
- Disaster Response
- Hands-on Training
- Program Security
- Child Care Training
- Situational Awareness
- Workplace Violence Prevention
- Emergency Communication
- On-Demand Courses

## Core Services & Training

- [Training Offerings](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/trainingofferings): Overview of ICP training programs including active shooter, situational awareness, and site safety courses
- [Security Assessment](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/assessment): Customized site security and risk assessment service for early childhood programs
- [Planning your Training](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/questions): Step-by-step guide for planning ICP training with group size considerations

## Emergency Communication Tools

- [Walkie Talkies](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/walkietalkies): Lightweight walkie talkie product designed for early childhood staff emergency communication
- [Texting](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/texting): SMS short-code messaging platform for rapid emergency communication with staff and families

## Compliance & Regulatory Support

- [Get Help with CA Workplace Violence Prevention Compliance](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/553): Compliance assistance for California SB 553 workplace violence prevention requirements

## Resources & Learning Materials

- [Resources](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/resources): Hub for ICP blog, books, printables, podcast, and newsletter resources
- [Books](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/books): Preparing for the Unexpected book series for early childhood emergency preparedness
- [Printables](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/printables): Free downloadable preparedness resources including flyers, social stories, and bilingual materials
- [Safety Spotlight](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/spotlight): Monthly action-oriented safety initiative for directors to enhance organizational preparedness

## Facility Safety Programs

- [Storefront Safety](https://www.childhoodpreparedness.org/storefrontsafety): Vehicle crash prevention and facility safety program for early childhood centers
